_notes.title: The repository's name, shown at the top of the page.
_notes.logFile: The exported git log, relative to this file (repo-pulse.log after the README's first command). null shows the sample year that ships with the app.
_notes.tagsFile: The exported tag list, relative to this file (repo-pulse.tags after the README's second command). null shows no releases, or the sample's when logFile is null too.
_notes.since: The first day to count, as YYYY-MM-DD; commits before it are left out. null counts the year up to the newest commit.
_notes.authorAliases: Names that are the same person: each key is a name as git has it, each value the name to count it under.
_notes.ignorePaths: Paths left out of the churn map and the line counts: a file name or pattern (pnpm-lock.yaml, *.min.js) or a folder ending in / (vendor/).
_notes.theme: auto follows the device's light or dark setting; paper is always light, terminal always dark.
